name: Rue des Gestes — étape 18 · délier, chiper, sévir
note: Last place of the Rue des Gestes. -er LEFT (deli man untying the string round his sausages, seagull pinching a chip from a man's cone, woman and puppy tugging a tea towel on the balcony, man pumping dumbbells at the upper window, peacock strutting before a tall mirror on the roof), -ir/-re RIGHT (stern policeman cracking down on a naughty goose). Forward = lane's end, round back to the square; back = near cobbles.
